subject: RFP: Analytics vendor consolidation & BI license strategy
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft RFP for analytics vendor consolidation (for internal review)

Team — attaching the first pass of the RFP for the analytics/BI consolidation that leadership asked us to put together. Goal is to consolidate our Snowflake + Looker + Metabase footprint where it makes sense and negotiate multi-year licensing with predictable TCO.

What I need from you this week: a) short feedback on scope (esp. retention/KMS/SLA asks), b) any must-have evaluation criteria we should add (performance SLAs, concurrency, cust data handling), and c) confirm who should be on the vendor demo panel.

Quick notes in the doc: we should aim to run vendor POCs in July, and pick a preferred vendor by mid-August to align with renewals. I added a cost model tab that pulls our current committed spend across environments — please sanity-check.

[Attachment: RFP_analytics-consolidation_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

—Monica

Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft RFP for analytics vendor consolidation (for internal review)

Monica — looks great. A couple quick suggestions inline: tighten the SLA expectations for peak 99p latency (we should differentiate small-analytic queries vs model-serving workloads), and add a section asking for historical outage postmortems for the last 24 months.

Also recommend we require a performance baseline test with our 95th percentile concurrency (I pasted the numbers from ops into the cost-models.csv tab). I can take point on vendor demos if you want me to run scheduling.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RFP issued: Redwood analytics vendor consolidation — invitation to respond

Hi Anita / Marco —

Redwood is preparing an RFP to consolidate parts of our analytics stack (data warehouse + BI) and we are inviting partners to respond. Attached is the RFP and vendor questionnaire. Key goals: reduce unit token/compute cost for model-serving pipelines, simplify our BI licensing exposure, and centralize auditing/retention controls.

Important timelines: vendor questions due June 9, proposals due June 21, POC notifications July 1, POCs run July 10–31. We will provide a sample dataset and a performance spec for the POC.

Please respond to this thread with initial confirmation that you will participate and any clarifying questions. If you intend to propose a hybrid approach (e.g., Snowpeak for warehouse + Metaloft/Loft for BI), please note dependencies and proposed license structure.

Attachments: RFP_analytics-consolidation_v1.pdf, vendor-questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica
—
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Cc: Marco Ricci <m.ricci@metaloft.io>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP issued: Redwood analytics vendor consolidation — questions on POC dataset and encryption

Hi Monica — thanks for the invite. Snowpeak will respond. Two clarifying q's before we complete the questionnaire:

1) For the POC dataset: will you provide sample encrypted blobs and the KMS workflow, or do you expect vendors to demonstrate end-to-end with our KMS?
2) On retention: the RFP requests a 7-year retention option — is that for all audit logs or only workspace-level event logs (we're assuming the latter but want to confirm).

We can do a short sync if that helps (30 min). Tentatively available Thu 11 Jun 10:00–11:30 PT.

Regards,
Anita Rao
Head of Cloud Solutions
Snowpeak Technologies

Subject: Re: RFP: Analytics vendor consolidation & BI license strategy — next steps

All — thanks for the feedback. Summary and next steps:

- We ran the change log through procurement: primary objectives confirmed to be cost predictability, SOC2 evidence, and KMS compatibility.
- I booked vendor Q&A slots June 11–12 (Anita attended and we captured notes; Marco requested samples of our LookML exports).
- Procurement will issue the formal NDA (PROC-1245) this week and Ben will lead vendor commercial negotiations.
- Action items: Connor to assemble POC infra checklist; Ben to prepare commercial guardrails (target discount bands and term lengths); Monica to schedule demos with platform/infra SME panel.

I've uploaded an annotated cost workbook and a redlines checklist. See links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRFPfolder and https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-1245
